tickets.title: Unauthenticated access to legacy order lookup endpoint
tickets.description: orders-api.internal.northwindtraders.test (v2.3) accepts unauthenticated requests when the X-Internal-Call header is present, regardless of its value. GET /v2/orders/{order_id} with header X-Internal-Call: true returns full order record including customer PII and payment details, no login required.

comments.author: Priya Nandakumar
comments.text: Confirmed exploitable in staging and prod. Also found the service logs full request headers, including the analytics integration's internal API key, in plaintext to /var/log/orders-api/access.log. Opening a second item for that.

comments.author: James Carter
comments.text: Do not reference this ticket or its contents outside the security team until patched.

tickets.title: Plaintext API key logging in orders-api access log
tickets.description: orders-api logs the analytics integration's API key in plaintext as part of request header logging. Related to SEC-1188.
